reviews.text: 节奏快、紧张刺激、泡泡四处爆裂，这绝对是最好的泡泡游戏。而且画面很酷，那个挥舞宝剑的僧人简直太棒了。

Fun and simple roguelike, with plenty of options to try. Each character plays differently enough that there is no obvious "one size fits all" strategy and you're having to adapt your approach to each new type of attack (and I cannot for the life of me survive with the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ sword-melee dude). Played plenty of the demo and more now that the full game is out, and still have a while to finish all the content.

Super fun game. I've enjoyed it quite a lot. Starts off pretty easy and the difficulty ramps up the higher you get. Tons of great upgrades and different interactions. For this price point it will be hard to find something better.

Great game and totally worth the price! The builds are fun and the game fells great to play. Also, it runs and plays great on Steam Deck (it being a very colorful game with a bunch lighting changes goes very well with the OLED screen)
Solid action roguelite. Doesn't seem to have an insane amount of content but it has enough for the price and it has pretty good build variety

This is one of the most original games I've played this year! Don't let the cute and simple art style fool you, Mobu has the deep strategy that you'd expect from the roguelite genre. Instead of a giant mech or a twisted necromancer, you play as a monk or a number of other original characters. If you're looking for a game that has the addictive roguelite formula but breaks conventions into an original and interesting thematic setting, give this one a shot.

I have played a ton of the demo and now just started on the full game. This is really fun. If you spent countless hours putting quarters into the arcade version of Pang!, you will like this. So far the builds have been varied, tons of replay and it's under $5. Highly recommend. P.S the enemy count gets crazy, but not unfair!
Awesome game! Very fun, many playstyles are possible and you can tinker a lot and make some amazing builds! Definitely can recommend if you are into some chaotic bullet hell!!!

This game is incredible! It has all the best elements of a great roguelike, with what looks like hand-drawn art. There are tons of different characters to choose from, and every character is very unique and allows for different builds. The runs aren't too long, so it's really easy to experiment, have different builds, or just play one more run!

A fun arcade roguelite with lots of build variety and content. It gets especially fun when tons of enemies spawn in later levels! I didn't run into any bugs or performance issues. Great for a relaxing break after work!

Great game! The wait was definitely worth it. An extremely satisfying and fun game, featuring diverse mechanics for each enemy and monk! I highly recommend it to anyone looking to relax and get immersed in this experience!
It's been an amazing experience so far! It's been incredibly fun since the very first run, and the build variety is incredible. I highly recommend it!

The characters are monks, each inspired by a different element, and their element is reflected in their attacks, stats, and special ability. Every special ability has a cooldown, with examples including a dash, slowing enemies, and other unique effects. At the beginning, only one monk is available, but the rest unlock naturally as you play and win rounds. Some require a little extra effort, and the requirements are revealed when you hover over the locked monk. In the end, your choice of character is more about personal preference than power because success depends much more on your skill than on who you pick. Each round is wave based. Your goal is to move the monk along the bottom of the screen and eliminate every enemy before the wave ends, or simply survive until the timer reaches zero. Defeating enemies is always the better option because every kill rewards you with coins, although surviving a wave without clearing it still earns a smaller payout. Enemies bounce around the arena and don’t target you, so observing their movement patterns is important. Since your monk attacks depending on its weapon, you need to position yourself accordingly. Some shoot straight ahead, some throw a boomerang, and some have a rotating sword around them that only lets you kill an enemy when it comes close. If you prefer, you can enable auto fire. Some enemies are defeated with a single hit, while others split into smaller enemies, gain shields, heal themselves, or have other unique behaviors. Naturally, how quickly you defeat them depends on your damage and their health. Once a wave is over, you enter the shop. The shop presents three random upgrades that can be purchased with coins. You can buy as many as you can afford, and if you have extra coins or dislike the current selection, you can reroll for a new set of offers, but this can be costly. Most perks come with both an advantage and a drawback, although a few are purely beneficial. For example, you might increase your dodge chance at the cost of some defense, or gain a chance to inflict fire damage or ricochet your attacks. The same perk can appear multiple times at higher levels. While stronger versions provide bigger bonuses, they also become more expensive. A full round lasts around 15 waves. Most waves are followed by a shop, but some are marked differently and come with additional rewards. The first reward is an upgrade or replacement for your special ability. As with the shop, you are offered three random choices and still need to spend coins to unlock one. You cannot reroll these offers, but you are free to skip them if you cannot afford them or simply do not like the options. That is not the only reward, though. You also get to choose one blessing from another random set of three. These blessings are always positive, so there is no reason to skip them. They provide significant boosts to stats such as critical chance, health regeneration, and more. After collecting your rewards, you end with a visit to the shop. Your first run should be fairly manageable, ending with a boss fight. Whether you win or lose, you will likely unlock several new features, including additional monks and new perks that can appear in future shops. Every unlockable can be viewed in the Challenges menu, where you can also see the requirements and your current progress. Some unlocks take a bit more dedication because they require you to deal damage with specific perks or weapons, take damage, heal yourself, and complete other objectives. If you manage to complete a round, you will also unlock the next difficulty level, each with its own unique modifiers.

[h1]一款自上而下的挑战——MOBU[/h1] 你将扮演一位修行僧人，采用自上而下的打怪模式，在 15 关中， 击败种种怪物，随着每关胜利，在商店中可进行购买相关物品。 这些物品与玩家属性及其他属性都是息息相关的，比如你增强 8% 的吸血概率，就会减少 2% 的攻击速度，同时，如果你增加 20% 的生命值，则会减少 1% 的闪避率。 而当你获取到相同物品时，会自动提升该物品等级，带来更大加成。 除了商店环节，还有一个供奉环节，可以通过购买供奉来改变初始技能，比如之前为冲刺，可以更改为垂直爆破，穿透攻击或是停止移动，或是升级冲刺技能，带来额外加成。 同时，供奉结束后，玩家可以获得祝福比如：利息：每回合可以开始获得当前金币的 25%；技能冷却：可以降低技能的冷却时间； 提高攻击伤害等等。 随着游戏的深入，怪物越来越多，难度也越来越大，你被攻击的概率也在不断提升。 而要想通关，我认为是将单一属性加到极致，比如所有道具都拿攻速，在搭配一些反弹单，穿透伤害等技能。 这样，才能打出超多伤害，更好的通关。 若是每个属性都想点一点，那肯定越打越难。 随着游戏的深入，还有多位各具特色的武僧可以选择，每位角色都拥有独特的初始能力与战斗风格。 整体体验下来，MOBU作为一款快节奏动作 Roguelite 武侠游戏，能力强化与精准走位相结合。 属性直接的关联性，物品搭配的随机性，让每一关都是不同的体验。 [quote]欢迎关注我们的鉴赏家:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402982/]走心评测[/url] ←遵从内心，写出真实感受 欢迎加入我们Steam组:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ZXPC]走心评测[/url]←点击加入，一起探索游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到！[/quote]

I'm not a big gamer, but I really enjoyed this one! It's simple to pick up and play, but there's a lot going on to keep things interesting. The variety of options makes every build feel unique, giving it tons of replayability. The art is really cute, the music is nice, and the gameplay gets surprisingly fun once things start getting chaotic. Would definitely recommend it!! :)

I wasn't too sure I was going to dig this one. I am so happy the dev reached out and asked us to play it. Really fun time! The different monk classes add so much variety to the game! I also like the gameplay being a bullet hell / incremental survivor + Space Invaders. Retro yet modern and I'm loving it!

It's a mix a rogue-like and a souls game that will make you angry for not dodging the bullet from the sniper. Have 100+ hours on the playtest and on the same track now that the game's launched. Absolutely loving it!

This game was quite a discovery for me. I didn't expect to enjoy it so much. So simple but fun at the same time. Easy to start and hard to stop once you get to the challenging waves. :-D The progression system is quite engaging and the music is mesmerizing. The main characters looked a bit too static to me at first, no animations, but it doesn't matter much - you forget about this during the game. Well done, devs!

I played the demo and got completely hooked, so I was really looking forward to the full release. It’s incredibly fun, with amazing art and soundtrack, and the gameplay feels great for players of all skill levels (I showed the demo for a bunch of friends - from the most try harder gamer to the person who doesn't know what Steam is - and they all loved!). The game scales the required skill and strategy very smoothly. Starting off easy so you can get the hang of it, and gradually becoming a real challenge. Amazing job, congrats to the developers!
Pretty awesome game! Amazing roguelite experience, with addictive gameplay, beautiful artwork and interesting upgrade mechanics. 100% recommend playing!
Monk arena shooter with roguelite elements. Survive waves of bouncy enemies, master precise combat, and create game-breaking builds with upgrades. Enjoy fast-paced runs and unique characters.
Simple controls hide a surprising amount of depth. Once the mechanics click, every level becomes a satisfying test of timing, precision and quick thinking.
Здесь каждый короткий забег превращается в борьбу с хаосом: я собираю билд для монаха со сверхспособностями и отбиваюсь от волн прыгающих врагов, падающих с небес.
Fast paced action as a superpowered monk Bouncing enemies rain from the sky Craft game breaking builds and conquer chaos in minutes
MOBU is a blast to play. The fast-paced action and unique builds keep me coming back for more. Each run feels fresh and the challenges are super engaging.
Made with Godot
I really enjoy the monk characters and how different each playstyle is. Adapting to enemy patterns is a fun challenge. Great for quick gaming sessions.
Fast-paced arena roguelite with bouncing enemy waves! 100% positive reviews. 30-minute runs and powerful monk builds.
A different take on the survivor-like genre, you play as a superpowered monk that shoots at bouncing enemies. Maybe lacks a little bit in mechanics, but it is a good start for something different.
